metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent demonstrated ability to navigate between slides, click title placeholders, and type/edit text. The trajectory started on slide 1 and the agent successfully identified the 'Sustainable Energy' title before switching to slide 2.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can click on title text boxes, select text, type replacement text, save the file
metadata.failure_analysis: Original failure was on slide 2 color picker. This variation targets slide 1 text editing which uses the same basic capability (click title, select text, type) without any color requirement.
metadata.task_rationale: Alternative sub-goal targeting slide 1's existing title text. Simple text replacement task based on the demonstrated capability of clicking title placeholders and editing text. Initial state 'Sustainable Energy' does not match 'Renewable Energy'.
metadata.explanation: Task requires clicking the slide 1 title, selecting the existing 'Sustainable Energy' text, and replacing it with 'Renewable Energy'. Evaluator reads the saved PPTX and checks that slide 1's PlaceHolder 1 text equals 'Renewable Energy'. llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads slide at index 0 (first slide) from the saved PPTX file, matching the instruction's target.
Getter searches for 'PlaceHolder 1' which is the standard LibreOffice Impress title placeholder name in PPTX files.
Metric correctly handles type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('expected_title') from the rules dict passed as expected.
Metric compares with .strip() equality which is appropriate for a text title match.
Expected value 'Renewable Energy' exactly matches the instruction's required title.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the updated state.
Initial state 'Sustainable Energy' would correctly fail; completed state 'Renewable Energy' would correctly pass.
Single-step instruction (change title text) is fully covered by the evaluator.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor robustness improvement: consider also checking shape.placeholder_format.idx == 0 as a fallback in case the shape name differs from 'PlaceHolder 1' in some PPTX variants, though this is unlikely to be an issue for LibreOffice-generated files.
